aiTurnsPerDauDay.via: logical distinct questions / dau / days — chunking law (never chunk count)

aiAdmissionsPerDauDay.via: chunks / dau / days — runtime & token admission surface, distinct from turns

coreCallsPerDauDay.via: logical turns + device-sync polls / dau / days — polling law (polls are requests, never turns)

inputTokensPerTurn.via: mean input tokens per chunk x chunks per logical turn — aggregation law, no double count

outputTokensPerTurn.via: mean output tokens per chunk x chunks per logical turn — aggregation law, no double count

providerAttemptMultiplier.via: measured attempts per primary turn — retry law (retries are attempts, never new turns)

aiMeanSeconds.via: text turn seconds + capture + ASR + TTS — voice law (audio-duration measured)

apiMeanCoreSeconds.via: weighted foreground core + poll seconds — polling law (foreground share assumed 0.2s per request)

apiResponseKib.via: foreground + poll response KiB means — byte distribution

apiRequestKib.via: foreground + poll request KiB means — byte distribution

voiceCaptureMinutesPerTurnMean.via: capture minutes per turn — voice law

asrInputTokensPerTurnMean.via: capture minutes x ASR input tokens per minute — voice law

ttsAudioGiBPerTurnMean.via: TTS output seconds x audio bytes per second — voice law

peakConcurrencyMultiplier.via: observed peak / observed mean concurrency during synchronized class starts — class-start law

workerJobsPerMau.via: logical Build runs + offline reconnects per MAU — Build law (each counted once)

workerMeanSeconds.via: weighted mean of Build (chunks x sec/chunk) and reconnect replay seconds

buildRunsPerMau.via: logical Build runs / mau — one logical run per Build, never per chunk

buildAdmissionsPerMau.via: total Build generation chunks / mau — runtime surface distinct from runs

offlineReconnectsPerMau.via: reconnect replay work items / mau — counted once per reconnect
